title: Crab in the Sand
lines: Beth digs in the wet sand.
It runs fast and slips in a crack.
Beth grins at the flat wet sand.
She sticks a twig in the sand.
The crab grabs it and is glad.

questions.ask: What does the crab grab first?
questions.listenFor: A stick. If they say the twig, point out the twig comes at the end and ask what came before it.
The crab grabbed the stick and surprised her. Cause and effect: the crab moved, so Beth jumped.

questions.ask: Do you think Beth is scared of the crab? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for evidence from the story, like "she jumped back" or "no, she gave it a twig."
